subject: Twilight handoff plan for EU demos & APAC follow-ups
thread_text:
From: Emma Li <emma@brightlytics.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 21:05:00 +02:00
Subject: Quick demo request + follow-up availability

Hi Stephanie,

We'd love a 45-minute demo of Redwood focused on serving economics and a short follow-up with our APAC engineering lead the next day. Our team is primarily Madrid and Singapore based, which makes scheduling a little tricky.

Can you/your team propose times that:
- cover a reasonable overlap for Madrid (UTC+2) and Singapore (UTC+8),
- allow a handoff so our SDR (in the US) can warm the AE and drop off after the first 10–15 minutes,
- and keep the APAC follow-up within the next 24 hours if possible?

Thanks — Emma
Emma Li
Head of Cloud Strategy, Brightlytics
emma@brightlytics.com

---

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Li <emma@brightlytics.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 15:10:00 -04:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick demo request + follow-up availability

Forwarding Emma's note — looks like Brightlytics wants a demo that sits in the Madrid-Singapore corridor with a US SDR->EU AE handoff. Can you both weigh in on AE availability and which "twilight" windows we can offer that minimize DST confusion?

Context / constraints:
- Emma prefers a 45-min demo + separate APAC follow-up within 24h.
- Logan: you're the proposed AE for this deal (D-2027-0789).
- I'm available to run the intro/warm the AE and stay first 10–15 minutes to cover immediate Qs.

Key ask: propose 2–3 concrete demo slots (with timezone conversions) that I can send to Emma today. Note any caveats around DST differences in late Oct (their timeline) so we don't create follow-up friction.

Thanks — Steph
Stephanie Nguyen
SDR, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Attachments: (none in this forward)

---

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Li <emma@brightlytics.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 15:42:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Twilight handoff plan for EU demos & APAC follow-ups

Thanks for the context, Steph. Quick notes on availability and DST:

Availability (next week):
- Option A: Tue Aug 24, 14:00 CEST / Tue Aug 24, 20:00 SGT (US SDR can do 08:00 PDT — Steph please confirm)
- Option B: Wed Aug 25, 17:30 CEST / Thu Aug 26, 23:30 SGT (late for APAC; prefer earlier)
- Option C: Thu Aug 26, 09:00 CEST / Thu Aug 26, 15:00 SGT (ideal for APAC follow-up same day)

My preference is Option C for a demo if they want a same-day APAC follow-up — it gives us an evening overlap for Singapore without pushing into midnight. Option A is the classic "twilight" window (Madrid late afternoon, Singapore evening) and is fine if APAC can do next-day follow-up.

DST note: EU (CEST) will still be in DST in August. US DST ends in early November. If Brightlytics wants to lock recurring follow-ups into October or later, call out that US/EU offsets will change. For now, all proposed times are DST-aware for Aug.

I can be on the demo and take Qs live. If the SDR needs to drop after the first 10, I can handle handover.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Li <emma@brightlytics.com>, Tom Keller <tom.keller@brightlytics.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 09:05:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Twilight handoff plan for EU demos & APAC follow-ups

Looping in a quick AE ops note:

- If we want a clean SDR->AE drop, mark the calendar invite with two blocks: 00:00–00:15 "Intro & context (SDR + AE)" and 00:15–00:45 "Product demo (AE leads)". That makes it explicit for the prospect who stays.
- Add meeting notes template in the invite (3 bullets: priority, success criteria, next steps) so APAC follow-up can pick up ASAP.
- I'll prep a one-sheet (MAP_v1.xlsx) with tailored success criteria and customer pain points — will attach when Steph sends the external invite.

Operational caveat: if the demo is near 23:00 SGT, the APAC follow-up next day needs to be very early (07:00 SGT) or mid-afternoon; confirm APAC lead's availability before promising same-day follow-up.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sales Enablement Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: planning checklist (will attach MAP_v1.xlsx when sending to prospect)

---

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@brightlytics.com>, Tom Keller <tom.keller@brightlytics.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 08:15:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Twilight handoff plan for EU demos & APAC follow-ups

Hi Emma / Tom —

Thanks again for the ask. Based on AE availability and our ops notes, below are three concrete windows that maintain the SDR->AE handoff and keep APAC follow-up options open. All times include local conversions (CEST / SGT / PDT) — please pick the one that works best.

Option 1 — Twilight (next-day APAC follow-up):
- Demo: Tue Aug 24, 16:30 CEST / Tue Aug 24, 22:30 SGT / Tue Aug 24, 07:30 PDT
- SDR (me) will intro + stay first 10 minutes, then drop; AE Logan leads.
- APAC follow-up: Wed Aug 25, 10:00 SGT (suggested)

Option 2 — Same-day APAC-friendly (preferred if APAC wants same-day):
- Demo: Thu Aug 26, 09:00 CEST / Thu Aug 26, 15:00 SGT / Wed Aug 25, 23:00 PDT
- SDR intro 10–15 min, AE leads.
- APAC follow-up: Thu Aug 26, 17:00 SGT (same day)

Option 3 — Evening EU / early APAC handoff (compromise):
- Demo: Tue Aug 24, 14:00 CEST / Tue Aug 24, 20:00 SGT / Tue Aug 24, 05:00 PDT
- SDR intro + drop at 15 min; AE leads the rest.
- APAC follow-up: Wed Aug 25, 09:00 SGT (next day)

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (one-sheet with tailored success criteria) and demo-agenda.pdf. Calendar invite (calendar-invite.ics) will be sent once you pick a slot; invite will include a two-block meeting layout per Marissa's recommendation.

Link: Mutual action plan draft: https://drive.redwood.com/MA-Plans/Brightlytics-MAP-v1

If one of these works, I'll send the formal calendar invite and add the meeting notes template. Also please confirm if your APAC engineering lead (name/email) should be invited to the demo or just the follow-up.

Best,
Steph
Stephanie Nguyen
SDR, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Cc: Tom Keller <tom.keller@brightlytics.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2027 09:30:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Twilight handoff plan for EU demos & APAC follow-ups

Thanks Steph — Option 2 works best for us (Thu Aug 26, 09:00 CEST / 15:00 SGT). Can you please include our APAC lead, Rajiv Menon (rajiv.m@brightlytics.com), on the follow-up invite only. For the demo, I'd like the AE to stay the full 45 and have the SDR drop after 10. Please go ahead and send the invite; the MAP looks great.

Regards,
Emma
